text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
“—That's all for today's live performance! 
Make sure you remember my name before you 
head home♪”

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: I know her~! Falco~! Do your best~!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Ooooh!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ehe, thank you, everyone! See you on the 
stage again soon~☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Today's concert was so exciting! Everyone 
was calling out my name so much!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Falco's fans are skyrocketing☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Or is saying that going too far... maybe?
choice_data_list:
You're definitely getting a lot of 
attention.

text_block_list.text:
Smart Falcon has been winning smoothly up 
to this point. Proof of her rising 
popularity as a promising dirt Umamusume—
choice_data_list: Take a look at this blog post.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: A blog...?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Wah, a dirt-race blogger? That's rare. 
Let's see...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
“—And that is why Smart Falcon, who showed 
someone like me—who only cared about 
racing—the potential of Winning Lives…”

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"No, let's close out this week's <Weekend 
Dirt Review> with some gratitude for 
Falco. Aim for the top Umadol, keep at it, 
Falco!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
choice_data_list:
The 'Umadol' concept is really catching 
on.

The 'Umadol' concept is really catching 
on, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Ehehe... I hope so.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Not so long ago, I only had a handful of 
fans you could count on one hand.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Before I knew it, so many people had 
started cheering for me...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone has high hopes for Falco. I 
really wanna do my best..."
choice_data_list:
You have to become one, you know — a top 
Uma-Dol!
I have to become one—the top Umadol!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Yeah!
On the way back—

text_block_list.name: Falco's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Whew, today's concert was amazing too! 
When Falco's the center, you really feel 
that all-out energy!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Hey, were those people over there watching 
our live performance?!
choice_data_list: Want to try calling out to them?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: No, no!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Right now Falco is off-duty. God-tier fan 
service only starts once someone calls out 
to me—

text_block_list.name: Falco's Fan B
text_block_list.text: Still, it's kind of a shame, though.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Huh.

text_block_list.name: Falco's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
She's aiming for the top in dirt races, 
right? Does that mean she won't be 
entering the Classic Triple Crown?

text_block_list.name: Falco's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, well, they probably won't run. They're 
on dirt because they lack the aptitude for 
it anyway.

text_block_list.name: Falco's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
"Still, wouldn't you have wanted to hear a 
girl who puts her all into it like that 
sing 'winning the soul'?"

text_block_list.name: Falco's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I really would've loved to hear it. 
On that super hyped-up Classic stage, you 
know?

text_block_list.name: Falco's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Right?! Falco swinging that mic stand 
around was seriously so cool~.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Ah, u-um... Shall we head home too, Falco?
